title: Mini Sculpt & Pop On-The-Go
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cream Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Medium Coverage

What it is: A mini set that pairs Mario’s viral, award-winning contour stick and blush stick for an effortless Sculpt & Pop On-The-Go.


Formulation: Stick


What Else You Need to Know: Create Mario’s signature SoftSculpt look effortlessly with a mini, creamy, buildable contour stick that swipes on seamlessly and dries down to a natural-matte finish. Don’t forget to add a healthy-looking, radiant flush to your cheeks with the mini cream blush stick, which delivers medium-buildable coverage for a soft pop of color, ideal for all skin types. Both sticks are noncomedogenic and non-pore clogging.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

MINI SOFTSCULPT® SHAPING STICK: 

-Smile softly to find the high point of your cheekbone, then apply the shaping stick along the cheekbone. Don’t go too close to your smile line. 

-To keep the application lifted, tap and blend upwards and outward. 

-To sculpt or warm up the forehead and jawline, put a little bit of product in the temple area and along the jawline and blend. 


MINI SOFT POP BLUSH STICK: 

-Smile softly to find the apples of your cheeks and apply the blush stick to the higher part of the apples towards the hairline. 

-Gently blend outward toward the hairline for a lifted look. 

-Pro tip: Dab onto lips for a monochromatic pop of color.

-Pro tip: Apply and blend with the F1 Brush (sold separately). 

-Gently press the stick down into the base and twist to propel formula up. You’re ready to sculpt and pop.

Ingredients+

SoftSculpt® Cream Contour & Bronzer Stick:

Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Mica, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Ozokerite, Synthetic Wax, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Polyglyceryl-2 Diisostearate, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Dipentaerythrityl Hexahydroxystearate, Octyldodecanol, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Stearalkonium Hectorite, Laureth-4, Propylene Carbonate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, BHT. May Contain/Peut Contenir: Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).


Soft Pop Cream Blush Stick:

Octyldodecanol, Diisostearyl Malate, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Synthetic Wax, Mica, Microcrystalline Wax, Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Wax, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate. May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Red 30 Lake (Ci 73360).
